notes: Call-site counting scope: src/, server/, api/, scripts/, index.html production code; node_modules, dist, docs/ and *.test.mjs excluded (tests cited as evidence only).
Internal same-origin calls (/api/*, navigator.sendBeacon to /api/realtime/debug-log in src/voice/realtimeDiagnostics.js:17) are not external and are not counted.

No Gemini / generativelanguage call site exists in production code or scripts on this branch; no axios, XMLHttpRequest or EventSource usage found (SSE is piped server-side via fetch in server/ondemand/sse.js).
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is deny-listed in code (server/ondemand/config.js:400) — recorded as env-only bypass with no call site.
Entries 'usgs-fdsn-source' and 'nasa-firms-source' are counted as native because they are the already-registered OnDemand tool backends (docs/ondemand-tools/*.json).
2026-10-20 cycle 2: openai-hud-summary migrated to OnDemand (v2/summaries/hud), elevenlabs env removed, three v2 foundation call sites added; bypasses 4 → 2 (OpenAI Realtime pair, 501 in serverless).

2026-10-21 cycle 3: OpenAI Realtime removed entirely (server/providers/openai/* and src/voice/realtime* deleted, /api/realtime/token removed); directBypasses reduced to 0; voice served by /api/ondemand/v2/voice/turn; 21 geodata tools implemented across 17 OpenAPI plugins with in-process toolInvoker (see integration-audit.json for 161 baseline call sites).
